picks.showTitle: Seek HIM First: A Come, Follow Me Podcast for Kids
picks.title: Isaiah 29: A Marvelous Work and a Wonder | Come Follow Me for Kids
picks.summary: What is the “marvellous work and a wonder” Isaiah prophesied about?In today’s Seek HIM First episode, kids will explore Isaiah 29 and learn about the Restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ and the coming forth of the Book of Mormon. Isaiah saw something amazing that would happen hundreds of years in the future, and today, we get to be part of that marvelous story!We’ll play a fun “Marvelous or Not Marvelous?” game, test our knowledge with trivia, and discover how we can look for the marvelous things Heavenly Father is doing in our lives.Scripture: Isaiah 29:14Come, Follow Me: Isaiah 13–14;
picks.reason: A child-friendly introduction to the Restoration through Isaiah's prophecy and Book of Mormon.

picks.title: When You Have the Power to Punish, Choose Mercy
picks.summary: Abraham Lincoln had the power to punish, yet when a desperate mother pleaded for her husband's life, he chose to listen, show mercy, and help restore two men to freedom. His story challenges Christian men to consider how they use authority, influence, and strength when someone is depending on them for compassion. Discover why true leadership isn't only about strength in conflict—it is also about mercy, restoration, and doing good when you have the power to act.   Join the mission. Be part of the impact — support here: 365 Christian Men Link
picks.reason: Story of Lincoln choosing mercy challenges Christian men on authority and compassion.
